name: progress-circle
title: Progress Circle
description: A circular progress indicator with SVG ring, multiple sizes, customizable color, and optional centered text content. Uses namespace exports: ProgressCircle.Root.

docs.lead: A circular progress indicator with SVG ring, any size, customizable color, and optional centered text content.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Progress circles accept any numeric size. Stroke width auto-scales proportionally.
examples.code:
<ProgressCircle.Root size={80} value={75}>75%</ProgressCircle.Root>
<ProgressCircle.Root size={48} value={75}>75%</ProgressCircle.Root>
<ProgressCircle.Root size={16} value={75} />

examples.title: Values
examples.description: Progress circles at different completion percentages.

props.name: size
props.description: The diameter of the circle in pixels

props.name: color
props.description: Tailwind stroke class for the progress ring color

props.name: children
props.description: Content displayed centered inside the circle
